question: What is the exalted status and subtle locus of the mātṛkā goddess?
premises: The mātṛkā becomes present in the citrā channel.
She is identified as the sovereign of the world.
Her presence is described as an assumed state.
inference: The mātṛkā, having entered the citrā channel, is the sovereign goddess of the world.
plain_english: Having entered the citrā channel, the mātṛkā is the sovereign goddess of the world.
